Signature verifies, signed by cn=viacheslav krylov.

findings.detail: REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES, SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW. A messenger rarely needs these; they allow reading messages, installing other apps or drawing over the screen.

findings.summary: 30 permission(s) are outside the expected messenger set.
findings.detail: ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION, ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, BADGE_COUNT_READ, BADGE_COUNT_WRITE, BILLING, BROADCAST_BADGE, CHANGE_BADGE, CHANGE_CONFIGURATION, DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION, FLASHLIGHT, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION. Review them before installing.
